blocks.prompt: 6. Find the equation of the circle passing through the point \((-3, -4)\) and touching the line \(3x - y - 1 = 0\) at the point \((1, 2)\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein circle do points se guzarta hai, aur un mein se ek point par ek line circle ko "touch" karti hai, yani tangent (woh line jo circle ko sirf ek point par chhooti hai) hai. Yeh Case 3 hai, Example 7 jaisa.
Diya kya hai? Point \((-3, -4)\), aur line \(3x - y - 1 = 0\) jo \((1, 2)\) par touch karti hai.
Find kya karna hai? Circle ki equation.
Rule kaunsa? Point of contact par radius tangent par perpendicular hota hai, is liye centre normal (tangent par perpendicular line) par hota hai.
Plan: do points se do equations, normal ki equation nikal kar centre us mein rakhna, phir \(g, f, c\).
steps:
Diya gaya: circle \((-3, -4)\) se guzarta hai aur line \(3x - y - 1 = 0\) ko \((1, 2)\) par touch karta hai.
Maloom karna: circle ki equation.
Tareeqa: Case 3. \((1, 2)\) bhi circle par hai (chhoone wala point circle ka hi point hota hai). Teesri condition: centre normal par hai, kyunke radius tangent par 90 degree banata hai.

\((1, 2)\) rakhein
\[1 + 4 + 2g + 4f + c = 0\]
\[2g + 4f + c + 5 = 0 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Point of contact circle \(x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) par hai.

\((-3, -4)\) rakhein
\[9 + 16 - 6g - 8f + c = 0\]
\[-6g - 8f + c + 25 = 0 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Doosra point bhi circle par hai. \(2g(-3) = -6g\), \(2f(-4) = -8f\).

\((1, 2)\) par normal
\[3x - y - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow m = 3\]
\[\text{normal slope} = -\tfrac{1}{3}\]
\[y - 2 = -\tfrac{1}{3}(x - 1)\]
\[x + 3y - 7 = 0\]
Kyun: Line ko \(y = 3x - 1\) likhein to slope 3 hai. Perpendicular slopes ka product \(-1\) hota hai, is liye normal ka slope \(-\frac{1}{3}\). Phir point-slope form: \(3y - 6 = -x + 1\).
Dhyan dein: Centre tangent par nahi, normal par hota hai; tangent ka slope istemal karna ghalat hai.

Centre normal par
\[(-g) + 3(-f) - 7 = 0\]
\[g + 3f = -7 \quad (3)\]
Kyun: Centre \((-g, -f)\) normal ki equation ko satisfy karta hai. \(-1\) se multiply kar ke saaf likha.

(3) aur (4) hal karein
\[(4) - (3):\ g = 12\]
\[12 + 3f = -7,\quad f = -\tfrac{19}{3}\]
Kyun: Dono mein \(3f\) hai, minus karne se ud gaya aur \(g = 5 - (-7) = 12\) mila.

Equation
\[x^2 + y^2 + 24x - \tfrac{38}{3}y - \tfrac{11}{3} = 0\]
\[3x^2 + 3y^2 + 72x - 38y - 11 = 0\]
Kyun: \(2g = 24\), \(2f = -\frac{38}{3}\), \(c = -\frac{11}{3}\) rakhe, phir 3 se multiply kar ke fractions hataye.

Tasdeeq (tangency)
\[\text{centre} = \left(-12, \tfrac{19}{3}\right),\ r^2 = \tfrac{1690}{9}\]
\[\text{distance} = \dfrac{|-36 - \frac{19}{3} - 1|}{\sqrt{10}}\]
\[= \dfrac{130}{3\sqrt{10}} = \dfrac{13\sqrt{10}}{3} = r \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(r^2 = 144 + \frac{361}{9} + \frac{11}{3} = \frac{1690}{9}\), \(r = \frac{13\sqrt{10}}{3}\). Centre se line ka perpendicular faasla radius ke barabar aaya; yahi tangent hone ki pehchan hai. Circle bara hai (radius taqreeban 13.7), figure mein dekhiye.
